mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id) AS permission_count, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(rp.permission_id) FROM role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id) AS permission_ids, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_role ur JOIN user_information u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.role_id = r.id AND u.status <> 0) AS user_count FROM role r ORDER BY r.id
SELECT id, code, name, description, status FROM role WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, code, name, description, status FROM role WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (code, name, description, status) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, module, create_time FROM permission ORDER BY module, id
